selectedMethod: D-50, reference-first image judgement in existing Playwright comparator
rootCause: The existing prose already required reference comparison, but the follow-up credited added effects and functional checks without recording remaining visible proportion/material/icon gaps. Missing machine-readable judgement and unresolved findings could disappear from the comparison output.

checks.transfer: Observed missing-status assertion fail before implementation, then full existing transfer test passed: pixel engine/decoder/baselines preserved; no assessment→NOT_REVIEWED; unresolved→NEEDS_WORK; unknown→UNVERIFIED; stale/partial reviews invalid; selected reference reviewed.

actualKnownCases.reviewer: Codex primary agent, reference-first vision review
actualKnownCases.basis: Compare selected reference and current appearance before crediting implementation effects or functional passes. Proportion, light distribution and icon weight are the observed open gaps for this component.
actualKnownCases.limitations: Known examples and same reviewer who implemented the prior change; no autonomous detection-rate, beauty or efficiency guarantee. Tool validates attachment/closure, not truth of perception. User preference remains open.

cases.summary: Selected reference positive control, identical pixels; no implementation approval follows.
Both the complete toolbar and equal-scale button were viewed in light; AF6C98F0 is visibly short of the chosen reference.

findings.expected: Wide, low visual body around88×36 with comfortable side space
findings.actual: Native body around81×40 appears narrower/taller in both themes
findings.action: Refine painted proportion/side padding in the existing list owner while retaining the40px hit target

findings.expected: A solid white pencil with weight coherent with the label
findings.actual: Fine outlined pencil reads much lighter than the bold label
findings.action: Refine the existing decorative icon weight without changing the control/event

findings.expected: Cool luminous teal with a broad smooth light transition and soft contact shadow
findings.actual: Flat fill and nearly absent surface light/contact depth
findings.action: Rebalance fill/light distribution/rim/shadow as one material; do not equate more effects with fidelity

findings.actual: Native different categories/content/30-item count and40px functional hit area
findings.action: Retain native content and hit target; this does not waive feasible proportion/material/icon differences
